edge_script.about: 2026-11-16 (release gate smoke, keep-rebuild-1116): the scripted client of plan keepedge. No model-driven agent: the model override names agent_model_class (tbench/agent_ext/swe32_edge_script.py, EdgeScriptModel), whose first query drives one scripted session per task through the server (fresh with the first reply dropped, rollback, appends, a dropped reply, two rollbacks in a row, a long-reasoning prompt until a reply is cut inside its reasoning at the bound and the rollback after it, an ordinary resend = a rebuild, a final append), sending the earlier replies back as the server returned them (reasoning_content) and Mini-SWE-Agent's format-error text after a dropped reply; it then submits an empty patch. thinking.about: 2026-11-12: the stock control with thinking ON (a plan whose servers are all stock names thinking: true; controller.stock_thinking). vLLM 0.24.0 serves with --reasoning-parser qwen3: the response's content is the text after </think> and the reasoning a separate field, which litellm hands Mini-SWE-Agent as reasoning_content (the same split as our --enable-thinking). The agents send chat_template_kwargs enable_thinking true (the model template's thinking-on header <|im_start|>assistant\n<think>\n, as ours), max_tokens 4096 counting the reasoning (as ours), temperature 0, and NO stop string: vLLM would apply it inside the reasoning too, where our MarkerStop arms only after </think>; the reply ends at the model's end of turn. History reasoning_dropped (the only value): stock vLLM 0.24 reads only an assistant message's `reasoning` field (vllm/entrypoints/chat_utils.py), Mini-SWE-Agent 2.4.2 through litellm sends `reasoning_content`, so every earlier reply reaches the template as its content only and renders without its reasoning (the template's rendering of a reply before the last user message). Our runtime's keep mode keeps each reply's reasoning ids in the stream: the two histories differ (not token-comparable); stock with the reasoning kept would need the agent to send `reasoning` (or vLLM to read reasoning_content). Checks: the login gate renders both headers and an earlier reply with the model's own template, vLLM's parser reads --reasoning-parser back (argv gate), the job probes the live server after READY (thinking-on prompt = thinking-off prompt - 2 tokens) and stock.check_server checks both (stock-thinking). NOT GPU-validated.
